name: Forecast demand per item and location
outcome: A demand forecast at the item and location level.
description: Predicting how much of each item will be needed at each stocking location over a horizon, from history, seasonality, promotions and whatever other signals the method uses. It is the input to scm.reorder-inventory and not the same job: a forecast nobody turns into a replenishment proposal still satisfies this outcome, and an engine that consumes somebody else's forecast claims that job rather than this one. The unit is part of the job, so a national or category total is not a forecast at item and location level. Whether a forecast is any good is judged by this job's measures, not asserted in its outcome.
